status: IMMUTABLE — frozen before the first computation; any change requires power_plan_v2.json
question: How much real FXTM L1 data is required, per horizon 5s-5min, for a future independent alpha replication to reach pre-registered statistical power?
forbidden: using observed +7.99bp/30s as an effect size

N_definitions.eligible_N: grid samples with a real forward tick inside the same segment (censoring rule)
N_definitions.label_valid_N: eligible samples with a finite net markout
N_definitions.non_overlapping_N: every ceil(rho)-th eligible sample, rho = h / median_inter_tick_ms
N_definitions.effective_N_method_A: ACF-based: n / (1 + 2*sum_k rho_k) with the initial-positive-sequence truncation AND a cutoff of first k where |rho_k| < 2/sqrt(n)
N_definitions.effective_N_method_B: block-based: n_nonoverlap / block_length (number of independent blocks)
N_definitions.INDEPENDENT_EVENT_N: independent blocks x independent quote-event bursts
N_definitions.rule: if A and B differ by more than 2x -> EFFECTIVE_N_UNCERTAIN = TRUE; both are reported, the more conservative is used downstream

block_length.method: first lag k where |ACF(k)| < 2/sqrt(n) (and >= the first non-positive ACF), computed on the 1-tick return series and on the h-horizon markout series
block_length.freeze_rule: ONE block-length function is estimated from data and then FROZEN; no per-horizon cherry-picking

power.effect_size_source: PREDEFINED economic hypothesis only — never the observed +7.99bp
power.estimator: one-sample t-test on the non-overlapping net series (mean != 0)

simulation.type: block bootstrap on the EMPIRICAL non-overlapping net series (not normal)
simulation.add_effect: delta added to every simulated sample

power.analytic_crosscheck: n = ((z_{1-a/2} + z_power) * sigma / delta)^2 with sigma from the real series

families.note: 5 horizons x 7 feature families x 4 models = 140

calendar.rule: calendar days != usable data days; estimate from the OBSERVED event rate and dependence structure

forbidden_phrasing: a bit more data may be profitable
the model is not strong enough
